description: This file defines type-related classes, functions, and metaclasses for data pipeline type annotations and subtype checks within the PyTorch data utilities. It includes custom type classes, subtype checking functions, and metaclasses for DataPipe classes, focusing on type safety and annotation handling.

classes.name: GenericMeta
classes.description: Metaclass for DataPipe classes, managing type annotations and subclass behavior.

classes.name: Integer
classes.description: A class representing integer types, subclassing numbers.Integral.

classes.name: Boolean
classes.description: A class representing boolean types, subclassing numbers.Integral.

classes.name: _DataPipeType
classes.description: Class that encapsulates type annotations for DataPipe instances, providing subtype checking and instance type verification.

classes.name: _DataPipeMeta
classes.description: Metaclass for DataPipe classes, handling type parameters, subclassing, and type validation.

classes.name: _IterDataPipeMeta
classes.description: Specialized metaclass for iterable DataPipes, adding iterator-specific behaviors.

methods.name: issubtype
methods.description: Checks if one type is a subtype of another, considering Python typing constructs.

methods.name: issubinstance
methods.description: Checks if data is an instance of a specified data type, considering type annotations.

methods.name: reinforce_type
methods.description: Method to reinforce or set the type annotation of a DataPipe instance, ensuring it is a subtype of the expected type.
